results.summary_before: This project implements a 12-hour clock with an AM/PM indicator, counting seconds internally and rolling over minutes and hours. The enable, reset and clock signals are taken from ui[5], ui[6] and ui[7], the seven minute bits are on uio[0] to uio[6], and the hour bits plus AM/PM flag are on uo[0] to uo[7]. It is tested by supplying a clock, a reset and a one-second enable pulse, and an LED display can optionally be attached to view the time. The documentation is brief and no silicon results are reported.
